discussion_comments.comment_body: Declining this one. No code path produces an image-shaped object inside tool arguments or tool schemas, so this is a theoretical under-count. If it ever occurred, the budget scaling from the provider's actual input count (compaction.ts, `underestimateFactor`) and overflow recovery already bound the damage. Scoping the replacer per path isn't worth the complexity.
Fixed in 202642e: numstat records split on the first two tabs only and the remainder is kept as the filename, with a test for a tab-containing name.

Fair point. Switched to splitting on `path.sep` only (same approach as the SDK's workspace file-indexer), so POSIX filenames containing a literal backslash are left intact. Added a POSIX-only test for that case.

Fixed in 2c1a7f7d7: normalization now recurses into `items` (object and tuple forms) and into `anyOf`/`oneOf`/`allOf` branches before the object-likeness gate, so nested uppercase types lowercase at every depth. Covered by the new "normalizes nested array items and combinator branches" test.
